name: Forward Warping for Novel View Synthesis
definition: A method for novel view synthesis of dynamic scenes that models a static scene at a canonical time step and forward warps the entire canonical field to other time steps. It addresses many-to-one and one-to-many mapping difficulties using differentiable forward warping with average splatting and an inpaint network.
summary: Forward Warping renders dynamic scenes by warping a canonical radiance field to target times, using average splatting and inpainting to handle mapping difficulties better than backward flow methods.
